ValidationRule.description: When KYC QA Case status is updated to 1 of the downgrade statuses, ensure that all checks must be completed AND 1 of them must be NO. ie. show error if 1 of the checks is blank OR all of them are 'Yes'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'KYC_QA', OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Rectify Defect'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Pending Documents'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Refer to Fraud') ), OR( OR( ISPICKVAL(Fraud_PO_Box__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_ID_Legible__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Address_Valid__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_ID_Not_Picture__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_MiddleNameCheck__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Customer_Details__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Security_Features__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Customer_Photo_Modified__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Selfie_Comparison_Match__c, '') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Fraud_PO_Box__c, 'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_ID_Legible__c, 'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Address_Valid__c, 'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_ID_Not_Picture__c, 'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_MiddleNameCheck__c, 'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Customer_Details__c, 'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Security_Features__c, 'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Customer_Photo_Modified__c, 'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Selfie_Comparison_Match__c, 'Yes') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All the checks should be completed with at least one check marked as No before changing the Status to Rectify Defect/Pending Documents/Refer to Fraud
